GO

CREATE PROC [BNKM].[SP_CasaTdAggregateBalance_DEP] AS 
BEGIN

--GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TEMP_BNKM_CasaTdAggregateBalance
AS
(
SELECT
BDG.FORACID AS CustomerAccountId
,'Month-to-Date Average Daily Balance' AS AggregateBalanceType
,BDT.CURRENT_EOD_DATE AS PeriodEndDate
,BDT.PREVIOUS_CURRBAL AS PreviousCurrentBalance
,BDT.PREVIOUS_CLEARBAL AS PreviousClearBalance
,BDT.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL AS AccumulatedCurrentBalance
,BDT.ACCUMULATED_CLEARBAL AS AccumulatedClearBalance
,BDT.BANK_ID AS FinancialInstitutionId
,'DEP' AS SOURCESYSTEMCODE
,BDT.INSERT_DTTM AS INSERTDTTM
FROM   BUSC.DEP_TBLDEPAGGRBALANCES BDT
LEFT JOIN BUSC.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER BDG ON BDG.ACID = BDT.ACID AND BDG.ISLATEST = '1'
WHERE BDG.FORACID IS NOT NULL AND BDT.ISLATEST = '1'


UNION

SELECT
BDG.FORACID AS CustomerAccountId
,'Year-to-Date Average Daily Balance' AS AggregateBalanceType
,BDT.CURRENT_EOD_DATE AS PeriodEndDate
,BDT.PREVIOUS_CURRBAL AS PreviousCurrentBalance
,BDT.PREVIOUS_CLEARBAL AS PreviousClearBalance
,BDT.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL AS AccumulatedCurrentBalance
,BDT.ACCUMULATED_CLEARBAL AS AccumulatedClearBalance
,BDT.BANK_ID AS FinancialInstitutionId
,'DEP' AS SOURCESYSTEMCODE
,BDT.INSERT_DTTM AS INSERTDTTM
FROM  BUSC.DEP_YTDDEPAGGRBALANCES BDT 
LEFT JOIN  BUSC.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER BDG ON BDG.ACID = BDT.ACID AND BDG.ISLATEST = '1'
WHERE BDG.FORACID IS NOT NULL AND BDT.ISLATEST = '1'
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CasaTdAggregateBalance FROM TEMP_BNKM_CasaTdAggregateBalance;

--CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA

WITH TEMP_BNKM_CasaTdAggregateBalance_SRC
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
convert(varchar,CustomerAccountId)
,convert(varchar,AggregateBalanceType)
,convert(date,PeriodEndDate)
,convert(numeric,PreviousCurrentBalance)
,convert(numeric,PreviousClearBalance)
,convert(numeric,AccumulatedCurrentBalance)
,convert(numeric,AccumulatedClearBalance)
,convert(varchar,FinancialInstitutionId)
))HASHROW, CustomerAccountId, AggregateBalanceType, PeriodEndDate,FinancialInstitutionId,SourceSystemCode
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CasaTdAggregateBalance 
),

TEMP_BNKM_CasaTdAggregateBalance_TGT
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
convert(varchar,CustomerAccountId)
,convert(varchar,AggregateBalanceType)
,convert(date,PeriodEndDate)
,convert(numeric,PreviousCurrentBalance)
,convert(numeric,PreviousClearBalance)
,convert(numeric,AccumulatedCurrentBalance)
,convert(numeric,AccumulatedClearBalance)
,convert(varchar,FinancialInstitutionId)
))HASHROW, CustomerAccountId, AggregateBalanceType, PeriodEndDate,FinancialInstitutionId,SourceSystemCode
FROM BNKM.CasaTdAggregateBalance
WHERE SOURCESYSTEMCODE = 'DEP'
),

TEMP_BNKM_CasaTdAggregateBalance_DELTA
AS
(
SELECT
SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerAccountId, TGT.CustomerAccountId) AS CustomerAccountId
,ISNULL(SRC.AggregateBalanceType, TGT.AggregateBalanceType) AS AggregateBalanceType
,ISNULL(SRC.PeriodEndDate, TGT.PeriodEndDate) AS PeriodEndDate
,ISNULL(SRC.FinancialInstitutionId, TGT.FinancialInstitutionId) AS FinancialInstitutionId
,ISNULL(SRC.SourceSystemCode, TGT.SourceSystemCode) AS SourceSystemCode
,CASE
	WHEN TGT.HASHROW IS NULL THEN 'INSERT' 
    WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
    ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS

FROM TEMP_BNKM_CasaTdAggregateBalance_SRC SRC
LEFT JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CasaTdAggregateBalance_TGT TGT
ON SRC.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId
AND SRC.AggregateBalanceType = TGT.AggregateBalanceType
AND SRC.PeriodEndDate = TGT.PeriodEndDate
AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
AND SRC.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW OR TGT.HASHROW IS NULL
)



SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CasaTdAggregateBalance_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_CasaTdAggregateBalance_DELTA;

UPDATE TGT
SET
CustomerAccountId = SRC.CustomerAccountId
,PeriodEndDate = SRC.PeriodEndDate
,PreviousCurrentBalance = SRC.PreviousCurrentBalance
,PreviousClearBalance = SRC.PreviousClearBalance
,AccumulatedCurrentBalance = SRC.AccumulatedCurrentBalance
,AccumulatedClearBalance = SRC.AccumulatedClearBalance
,FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
FROM BNKM.CasaTdAggregateBalance TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CasaTdAggregateBalance_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId 
AND DELTA.AggregateBalanceType = TGT.AggregateBalanceType
AND DELTA.PeriodEndDate = TGT.PeriodEndDate
AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
AND DELTA.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode
AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CasaTdAggregateBalance SRC ON SRC.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId
AND SRC.AggregateBalanceType = TGT.AggregateBalanceType
AND SRC.PeriodEndDate = TGT.PeriodEndDate
AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
AND SRC.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode
;

--INSERT TO BNKM
INSERT INTO  BNKM.CasaTdAggregateBalance
(
CustomerAccountId
,AggregateBalanceType
,PeriodEndDate
,PreviousCurrentBalance
,PreviousClearBalance
,AccumulatedCurrentBalance
,AccumulatedClearBalance
,FinancialInstitutionId
,SOURCESYSTEMCODE
,WORKFLOWID
,TASKRUNID
,INSERTDTTM
)

SELECT
SRC.CustomerAccountId
,SRC.AggregateBalanceType
,SRC.PeriodEndDate
,SRC.PreviousCurrentBalance
,SRC.PreviousClearBalance
,SRC.AccumulatedCurrentBalance
,SRC.AccumulatedClearBalance
,SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
,'DEP' AS SOURCESYSTEMCODE
,0 AS WORKFLOWID
,0 AS TASKRUNID
,SRC.INSERTDTTM
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CasaTdAggregateBalance SRC
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CasaTdAggregateBalance_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerAccountId = SRC.CustomerAccountId 
AND DELTA.AggregateBalanceType = SRC.AggregateBalanceType
AND DELTA.PeriodEndDate = SRC.PeriodEndDate
AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
AND DELTA.SourceSystemCode = SRC.SourceSystemCode
WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'INSERT'

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CasaTdAggregateBalance;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CasaTdAggregateBalance_DELTA;

END
GO
